caption: A bucket of water is poured over a dying campfire, and the fire goes out with a hiss in a cloud of steam and smoke.

sa.check: A campfire burns with small flames.
Water is poured over the fire from a bucket.
The flames go out where the water lands.
A cloud of steam and smoke rises.
The pour comes first and the cloud follows.

pc.expect: The flames go out where the water lands and the ash there goes dark and wet.
pc.fail: The water lands and the flames burn on unchanged; or the flames go out before the water reaches them; or the flames go out in a part of the fire the water never reached while the wetted part burns on; or the ash stays dry and pale where the water has soaked it.

pc.expect: The water falls downward onto the fire while the steam and smoke rise, spreading and thinning.
pc.fail: The water travels upward from the bucket; or the cloud sinks and pools around the fire; or the cloud hangs as a fixed shape without rising; or the water runs uphill out of the fire pit.

pc.expect: The fire only dies: doused flames do not flare back up and the wetted ash stays dark.
pc.fail: A doused part of the fire flares up again with nothing added; or the wet ash dries and glows again; or the flames shrink and grow in turn while water keeps pouring; or the ash gathers back into unburnt wood.

pc.expect: The water falls as a thin liquid and soaks the ash, the cloud is soft and spreading, and the logs stay charred solids.
pc.fail: The water bounces off the fire as a solid lump; or the cloud holds a fixed rigid shape; or the logs melt or flow; or the water sits on the ash as beads that do not soak in.

pc.expect: One bucket and one fire; the logs keep their number and the water goes only from the bucket to the fire.
pc.fail: A log vanishes at a stroke; or a new log appears; or water appears in the fire pit with none poured there; or the bucket passes through a log.

pc.expect: The fire's stones, the ground and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The stones rearrange; or the ground changes texture away from the water; or the background changes between frames.

note: The hiss is sound and is not judged.
